summary: List leftover ACME challenge records of a DNS credential

parameters.name: credentialID
parameters.description: ID of the DNS credential, as the list shows it

200.description: The leftover `_acme-challenge` TXT records in the credential's domains

400.description: Every zone failed: the provider refused the credential or the request failed (`error.dns-cleanup-failed`)

404.description: The credential does not exist or belongs to another user

description:
Lists the TXT records named `_acme-challenge` or below it in the credential's domains (its zones), read from the provider with the saved secret opened for this one call. Only TXT records are listed; CNAME records at those names (a delegation) are left out and counted in `skipped_cnames`. At most 500 items across the zones and 25 pages per zone (`truncated`). A zone that cannot be listed is named in `failed_zones` and the others are listed; only when every zone fails is the answer 400. `age_seconds` comes from the provider's change time and is null when the provider gives none; `recent` is true under 10 minutes; `preselected` only for a known age over 1 hour. While a certbot run of this instance is going on `busy` is true and every item is in use. A credential without domains answers no items and `error_i18n` `error.dns-cleanup-no-domains`. For a provider without a confirmed list and delete `supported` is false and no outside request is made.

Needs: Certificates manage
